title: Component-Aware Structure-Preserving Style Transfer for Satellite Visual Sim2Real Data Construction
abstract: arXiv:2605.19624v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: For camera-based satellite visual sensing, Sim2Real data construction requires images that approach real-domain sensor appearance while retaining the annotations inherited from simulation. Real sensor images of satellite targets with reliable pose labels and component-level masks are difficult to acquire at scale, whereas synthetic rendering provides exact geometric annotations but suffers from a visible appearance gap. This paper presents a component-aware structure-preserving style transfer framework for satellite visual synthetic-to-real data construction. The method builds weakly paired real--synthetic samples from calibrated real acquisition, ArUco-based camera-pose measurement, CAD rendering, and component masks. It then extracts part-wise real-domain style codes from unlabeled real images and injects them into corresponding synthetic satellite regions through mask-aligned modulation. translated_title: 面向卫星视觉模拟到真实数据构建的组件感知结构保持风格迁移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.19624v3 公告类型：替换交叉  摘要：对于基于相机的卫星视觉感知，模拟到真实（Sim2Real）数据构建需要图像接近真实域传感器外观，同时保留从模拟中继承的标注。具有可靠姿态标签和组件级掩膜的卫星目标真实传感器图像难以大规模获取，而合成渲染提供了精确的几何标注，但存在明显的外观差距。本文提出了一种组件感知的结构保持风格迁移框架，用于卫星视觉合成到真实数据构建。该方法从校准的真实采集、基于ArUco的相机姿态测量、CAD渲染和组件掩膜中构建弱配对的真实-合成样本。然后，它从未标记的真实图像中提取部件级真实域风格编码，并通过掩膜对齐调制将其注入相应的合成卫星区域。为了保持生成图像的可用性，...
tldr: 本文提出一种组件感知、结构保持的风格迁移框架，通过弱配对样本和掩膜对齐调制，将真实域部件风格注入合成卫星图像，实现保留标注的模拟到真实数据构建。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a component-aware, structure-preserving style transfer framework that injects real-domain part styles into synthetic satellite images via weakly paired samples and mask-aligned modulation, enabling Sim2Real data construction with preserved annotations.
